projects.label: — SELECTED PROJECTS / 2025–2026
projects.subtitle: What I've been building this year.

approach.label: — APPROACH
approach.body: Started coding in May 2025. Working through fullstack — React, TypeScript, Node, Postgres. Right now: building a solid foundation.

aether.description: Landing page experiment. Minimal design, smooth scroll, custom cursor.
aether.fullDescription: Landing page for a UI library concept. Custom cursor, scroll animations, minimal type. First time I tried to make something that actually looked intentional. Focused heavily on spacing and visual rhythm.

2048.description: Classic 2048 game in vanilla JS. Built while learning OOP and async patterns.
2048.fullDescription: Classic 2048 in vanilla JS — no framework, no libraries, just the DOM. First project where I had to think through a real algorithm before writing a single line. Learned what OOP actually feels like in practice.

yatzy.description: Full Yatzy game in vanilla JS. Built in 2 days for a school assignment. Logic and DOM kept separate.
yatzy.fullDescription: Full Yatzy with all the scoring rules — Yatzy, full house, and the rest. Logic and DOM in completely separate files, which I thought was overkill until I had to debug it. Built in two days for school, cleaned up after.

stasis.description: Landing page for a fictional longevity clinic. React 19, Tailwind v4, Framer Motion.
stasis.fullDescription: Landing page for a fictional longevity clinic. The brief I gave myself: make it feel expensive. React 19, Tailwind v4, Framer Motion. Probably the most design-focused thing I've built.

hdufndsk.description: Awareness landing about driving under influence. Built with serious topic in mind, not just visuals.
hdufndsk.fullDescription: Awareness site about driving under influence. Social platform that stayed an experiment — the backend is there, Node and Express, first real API I wrote myself. Still live, still rough.

kropp-fitness.description: My first landing page. Pure HTML and CSS. Where I learned what semantic markup means.
kropp-fitness.fullDescription: My very first landing page. Pure HTML and CSS, zero JavaScript. I had no idea what semantic markup was when I started. By the time I finished, I did.

skrekkeparken.description: Halloween map-game school project. Leaflet, geolocation, JSON-driven scenarios.
skrekkeparken.fullDescription: Halloween park map-game built as a school project with three classmates. Leaflet.js for the interactive map, geolocation for player tracking, JSON-driven event scenarios. Built in a week.

date-time.description: Wallpaper engine theme with live clock and date. Vanilla JS, Date API, CSS animations.
date-time.fullDescription: Wallpaper Engine theme — live clock and date that updates every second. Vanilla JS, the Date API, and a lot of CSS transitions. Compact utility with practical daily use.

redbeardvfx.description: Portfolio site for a VFX supervisor. Active client project, currently live.
redbeardvfx.fullDescription: Portfolio for a VFX supervisor. The site is live. Active project — working through the remaining requirements before final handoff. First time building something to someone else's creative vision, not my own.

todo-react.description: Fullstack task manager. React, Node, Express, connected to a real database.
todo-react.fullDescription: Fullstack task manager. React on the front, Node and Express on the back, connected to a real database. First time all the pieces were actually talking to each other end to end.

skan-jus.description: Landing page for a fictional Norwegian law firm. Dark theme, gold accents, custom cursor.
skan-jus.fullDescription: Landing page for a fictional Norwegian law firm called Skan Jus. Dark theme, gold accents, custom triangle cursor. Built to practice Tailwind v4 design tokens and get comfortable with custom cursor logic.

norden-verk.description: Landing page for a fictional Norwegian furniture workshop. Custom hammer cursor.
norden-verk.fullDescription: Landing page for a fictional Norwegian furniture workshop. Custom hammer cursor that changes shape on hover and click. Smooth scroll with Lenis, scroll animations with Framer Motion. Context API for global state.

greenfield-farms.description: Multi-page farm site. React Router, Feature-Sliced Design, component tests.
greenfield-farms.fullDescription: Multi-page site for a fictional farm. Home, visit, and 404 pages with React Router. First project I structured with Feature-Sliced Design — widgets, pages, shared. Also the first time I wrote component tests.

nordic-market.description: E-commerce with Nordic design. In progress.
nordic-market.fullDescription: E-commerce site with Nordic aesthetic. Designing the data layer and component architecture.

background.label: — BACKGROUND
background.body:
I'm Amadi Masuev. First year at Porsgrunn videregående skole — IT and media production.

Started programming in May 2025. Build fullstack projects with React and Node.js. Currently learning Next.js and expanding into backend architecture.

learning.label: — LEARNING PATH
learning.subtitle: Where I am, where I'm going.

items.title: Understand before you build.
items.body: If I copy code without understanding it, I forget it in a week. So I read first, then write.

items.title: Finish before you start.
items.body: Better to finish one project and learn what 'done' means than start ten and abandon them.

items.title: Names matter.
items.body: Bad variable names are bugs waiting to happen. I rename until things become obvious.

hero.line2: Short or long, I'll read it.
